title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1985-06-16
lineage: Sony PCM-M1 -> Sonic Sense Modified Sony 7 Pin Coax -> Zoltrix Nightingale (coax Mod) -> Cooledit 2k (sample rate conversion) -> CDWAV -> SHN
source: Schoeps MK41 (90deg spaced spaced 17 cm- aka DIN variant -- Tapers' Section) -> CMC4 ->Oade M118 prototype "b" -> Oade Modified PCM-F1 -> DAT (x3?) (48khz)

ai_review.summary: Crisp, clean audience recording captures a vibrant show with standout Scarlet Begonias, Fire on the Mountain, and a rare complete Cryptical Envelopment.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the energy of the night, highlighting the powerful delivery of Scarlet Begonias, an exciting Fire on the Mountain that led into a full Cryptical Envelopment – a rarity since the early ’70s. The recording is described as crisp and clean, making the performance enjoyable to listen to even years later.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 4‑star reviews praise both the musical moments and the clear sound quality; with limited data the rating reflects a strong show and good recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as crisp, clean and downright enjoyable; no dropouts or balance issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic flow with a memorable transition from Fire on the Mountain into a full Cryptical Envelopment, creating a highlight for the evening.
